item.description: The one person to judge: a list-prepare slot {i, item_key, label, query, queries?, item?}, a list-prepare accepted entry {index, item, item_key, query, queries?}, or a plain {name, company, ...}; the nested item is the person {name, company, role?, profile_url?, profile_text?}. null = empty slot.

name.description: The person's full name. Required unless item is given.

company.description: Where they work now. Required unless item is given.

role.description: Their title as the user knows it.

profile_url.description: A public profile or bio page the user says is this person.

profile_text.description: Profile text the user copied themselves (summary, About section, recent posts). Cited as input:profile_text, medium confidence at most. Nothing is fetched from a profile site.

problem.description: The problem the seller solves and who usually owns it.

owner_roles.description: Roles or functions that typically own the problem.

rubric.description: Optional scoring criteria about the person. Absent: a rubric is derived from problem (dated current title as a must-have, in-window activity, on-topic activity, an exclusion for having left). Score = 6 x met weight / non-exclusion weight, rounded half up; an exclusion met gives 0, a must-have not met caps at 2.

active_within_days.description: Public activity counts when dated inside [now - active_within_days, now].

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601. Optional: on JoyStream the template binds it to the run start time. Never guessed.
